I'd heard of this place after infinitechan's glowing praise for it. I've actually been linking to this place as I do see some quality discussion on here, and now I figure it's high time I finally actually JOIN and start contributing to it. I suppose I'm partially driven by the "if you build it, they will come" sort of angle, but I do think Voat's founders are worth supporting as well, whatever my misgivings are about voting systems for threads and comments.

... and in all honesty, I do have misgivings. My trajectory to Voat started from the heyday of GameFAQs. I was there for the heyday of LUE and the eventual sell-out by CJayC. It was my home for a while until a few brief stints in other places, before I hitched a ride onto 4chan, where I just posted on /m/ first, and then /v/ and eventually some parts of /vg/ with the occasional /a/ and /tg/ visit. GameFAQs taught me the pitfalls of personality cults while 4chan taught me the value of anonymity with regards to ideas.

But... both have taught me that things go to shit no matter what system is in place, due to the people that are running it. Which brings me back to the Voat founders; even if I'm used to and prefer anon status, the Voat guys look like they've got good heads on their shoulders, so I'll give this a try. Not my first rodeo with online communities relying on names, and perhaps it won't be my last. Hell, I even Tweet too so there's that.

In any case, here's hoping to the start of a long and beautiful relationship. If not that, then perhaps a spectacular crash and burn.
